documents.title: Strengthening the Korean Economy / Tasca Mission Report excerpt
documents.documentNumber: S/S-NSC files, lot 63 D 351, NSC 156 Series
documents.author: Henry J. Tasca mission; transmitted by James S. Lay Jr.
provenance: National Institute of Korean History FRUS DB
documents.originalLocation: FE files, lot 60 D 330, Tasca Report (full report referenced by FRUS note)
claims: Eisenhower appointed Tasca 1953-04-09 and defined assistance/utilization/coordination mandate
mission arrived Korea 1953-04-17 and consulted UNC agencies, UNKRA, each ROK ministry, National Assembly committee chairs and Korean Chamber of Commerce
report explicitly thanks Prime Minister Paik Too Chin for cooperation
recommended program was based largely on a ROK five-year plan but modified toward key reconstruction sectors
recommended expanded CEB role in fiscal/economic policy
recommended stronger Monetary Board monetary/credit/foreign-exchange authority
recommended single effective exchange rate and coordinated price/wage reform
recommended sale/long lease of state enterprises and greater private-sector role
recommended Korean participation in offshore procurement and aid planning/procurement
recorded ROK-government dissatisfaction with UNKRA procurement exclusion
endorsed FAO-derived agriculture measures and broader health/housing/education/technical-training reconstruction
recommended unified U.S./UN economic coordination centered operationally on a Korea-based special representative
attributionWarnings: report recommendations are not ROK decisions
report postdates Hwang Jong-ryul tenure ending 1953-05-28
Baek cooperation does not establish his position on individual recommendations
all ministries consulted does not prove every minister personally attended
